body:

**🇬🇧 English**


**INFORMATION**: This pack was created for the ShadowSMP Hardcore SMP server. It includes performance mods and the Simple Voice Chat mod to enhance gameplay. Note: This modpack is intended exclusively for a Dutch-speaking audience.

Every player on the server needs to use this pack.

                                        Features
                                        
Here are some examples of features that we will have in the modpack.

- **Shaders**- A feature that makes the look of the game a bit nicer
- **Voice chat**- Use voice chat in game with Simple Voice Chat

🇳🇱 Nederlands

**INFORMATIE**: Deze pack is gemaakt voor de ShadowSMP Hardcore SMP server. De pack bevat performance mods en de Simple Voice Chat mod om de speelervaring te verbeteren.

Elke speler op de ShadowSMP dient deze pack te gebruiken.

                                        Features

- **Shaders**- Shaders zorgen ervoor dat de game er mooier uitziet
- **Voice chat**- Gebruik spraak in game door deze mod



**HOW TO INSTALL**:
1. Download the Modrinth app via this site
2. Search for ShadowSMP and click Install
3. Run the instance, remember to check your settings/key binds and most important remember to have fun!


Heb je vragen over de pack? Join onze [Discord](https://discord.gg/qHt6HXcYXN) en wij zullen ze beantwoorden!
_Deze pack is geïnspireerd op de CreatorSMP Modpack_
